## Como obter os valores reais

- `telegram_bot_token`: BotFather (/settoken) ou variavel TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN no vault.
- `telegram_webhook_secret`: env TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET (HMAC token configurado no webhook).
- `x_api_key_dpo`: env CARTORIO_API_KEY no .env / vault / Supabase secrets.
- `x_api_key_n8n`: env N8N_API_KEY do workflow N8N.
- `openclaw_gateway_token`: env OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN (Tailscale SSH 100.99.172.84).
- `jwt_dpo`: POST /api/v1/auth/login com username/password DPO.
